text:
[Council File 26-0161; CD 14]
General Services Department report relative to maintenance responsibilities, work order repairs, and capital improvements for City-owned properties at El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument (El Pueblo); and, El Pueblo Department report relative to an overview of the leasing portfolio and practices, rent arrears, vacancies, and management strategies to improve long-term sustainability.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Review maintenance, work order repairs, capital improvements, and leasing practices for El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument.

locations.text: El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument, Los Angeles, CA

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment Committee approved as amended (Aug 25, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 4, 2026); Council action final
